content.text: KATES & BARLOW:BOSTON​'S​ PREMIER FAMILY LAW FIRM At Kates & Barlow we practice exclusively in the area of Family Law. When you’re facing complex personal and financial issues arising from separation, divorce, child custody, pre- or post-nuptial agreement, guardianships and other Family Law issues, you want a legal team with the depth of experience to help you reach a successful resolution of your case. You'll find that team at Kates & Barlow. The partners at Kates & Barlow offer a combined total of over 100 years of experience in all aspects of Family Law including negotiation, mediation, arbitration, and litigation with extensive experience in high-conflict and complex matters. When you retain Kates & Barlow, you get a team dedicated to your case, and you are an integral part of that team.
